title: Constellation view: multi-metric route & model performance charts
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and spec for a new 'Constellation' performance canvas that surfaces per-model and per-route latency, throughput, and token metrics in a cohesive multi-chart layout. The goal is to let engineers and SREs quickly correlate token volume, token distribution, and model latency spikes while keeping cost attribution visible. This ticket covers high-fidelity chart specs, interaction patterns, prototype links, engineering handoff notes, and review feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Chart set renders p50/p95/p99 latency lines, median tokens/request, and RPS in a synchronized time window with linked brushing.
Deploy/rollout annotations and model-version filter are available and persist across page reloads.
Cost overlay can be toggled on/off and shows cost-per-1k-tokens and estimated per-hour spend for the visible range.
Backend endpoint for 1-minute pre-aggregates (latency percentiles, token stats, rps) is documented and consumed by the prototype.
Prototype performance on realistic datasets (100k points / 7 days) remains interactive (sub-200ms hover response) via downsampling or WebGL rendering strategy.
Accessibility: color palette passes contrast requirements; tooltips keyboard-focusable and navigable.
design_notes: Layout: top row – timeline with RPS (area) + deploy markers; middle row – paired charts (left latency percentiles, right token distribution stacked area split by prompt/response); bottom row – small multiples showing top 6 routes (compact p95 sparklines + cost delta). Chart specifics: all charts use aligned 1-minute buckets when range <= 7d, otherwise 5-minute. Latency: show p50 (solid), p95 (dashed), p99 (dotted) with explicit legends; show moving average overlay (10-min) as faint line. Token chart: stacked area for user tokens vs assistant tokens; a thin line for average tokens/request. Throughput chart: smoothed area with instantaneous RPS dots for anomaly markers. Annotations: vertical markers for deploys, rollouts, autoscale events—hover reveals commit/PR link. Interaction: linked hover and crosshair; range brush to zoom; saveable view presets; model-version & route filters by typeahead and multi-select. Export CSV button exports visible aggregated buckets. Visuals: minimized gridlines, soft gray background, high-contrast color for p95 and cost overlay (orange). Performance trade-offs: prefer backend pre-agg with optional streaming for microtraces; client-side downsampling used for large ranges.
decision_log: 2025-02-11: Chose 1-minute pre-aggregates as default aggregation for 0-7d ranges to balance precision and telemetry cost.
2025-02-13: Use percentiles (p50/p95/p99) instead of mean for latency to better surface tail latency; moving average included for trend detection.
2025-02-15: Cost overlay implemented as a toggled line computed client-side from tokens * per-token-cost rate; engineering requested server-side verification for accuracy—added follow-up task.
2025-02-18: Rendering strategy: prototype uses Canvas2D with downsampling; engineering to evaluate WebGL for 7+ day heavy datasets if rendering lags.
2025-02-19: Accessibility colors finalized after contrast review: p50 blue (#1F77B4), p95 orange (#FF7F0E), p99 purple (#9467BD), cost overlay red-orange (#E4572E).

review_feedback: Priya (PM): emphasize cost correlation view—add a configurable threshold that highlights when cost per minute increases > 20% relative to baseline.
Marco (ENG): telemetry schema needs a 'token_breakdown' field per request; otherwise computing stacked areas requires heavy client joins—suggest server-side aggregation.
Sofia (Design): reduce legend clutter by allowing legend collapse and inline swatches; propose micro-interaction for toggling percentile lines.
Evan (SRE): add error-rate overlay (5xx/4xx) as faint red band to quickly correlate latency spikes with errors.
